feature_definitions.projected_points: DobberHockey fantasy projection (G+A skaters, W*2+SO*3 goalies); coef 0.0 for G (goalies use proj_wins)
feature_definitions.projected_points_sq: projected_points squared (skaters only; dropped with refit if it fits positive)
feature_definitions.pts_hinge_60: max(projected_points - 60, 0) — piecewise slope change at 60 pts (F/D)
feature_definitions.pts_hinge_80: max(projected_points - 80, 0) — piecewise slope change at 80 pts (F only)
feature_definitions.team_probability: preseason Stanley Cup win probability %, vig removed
feature_definitions.log_rank: ln(rank of projected_points among same-position players in the season auction pool, descending, ties=min); coef 0.0 for G
feature_definitions.log_lag: ln(max(last season's FCHL salary in $M, 0.5)); use ln(0.5) when has_lag = 0
feature_definitions.has_lag: 1 if the player had an FCHL salary the previous season, else 0
feature_definitions.proj_wins: goalies only — projected wins from goalie_projection_stats.csv (2020-2021 scaled 56->82); if unavailable, estimate as projected_points / goalie_pts_per_win

metadata.stage_1: logistic regression -> P(salary == $0.5M floor); trained on standardized features, exported coefficients are DE-standardized (apply directly to raw features)
metadata.stage_2: OLS on log(salary), above-floor players only; pts^2 dropped with refit when its coefficient is positive (KKT-correct <= 0 constraint)
metadata.sigma_model: sigma = max(sigma_intercept + sigma_slope * log_pred, sigma_floor); values already include the MAD->SD correction sqrt(pi/2) — use directly as a normal SD
metadata.expected_price: p_floor * 0.5 + (1 - p_floor) * E[clip(LogNormal(log_pred, sigma), min_bid, max_bid)] (closed-form clipped-lognormal mean, NOT the median)
